source: docs/autoresearch-handoff/ (Bases de datos.pdf, provided by Emmanuel 2026-06-11)
purpose: Authoritative external-source registry for the zebrafish-biomedicine RAG. Each source maps to the RAG data-niches (niches.json) it feeds. External identifiers retrieved from these sources are still verified + raw-cached per CLAUDE.md §6/§7.9 before use; agents are NOT exempt from these even when the internal DATA INAMOVIBLE already has data (GWT v1.1 §3.3).

databases.name: ZFIN
databases.utility: Mapping of zebrafish transcription factors; gene expression, clones, mutants, markers.
databases.data_type: TFs, gene expression, clones, mutants, markers

databases.name: DanioCODE
databases.utility: Identify which regulatory elements respond to which signals and when.

databases.name: Reactome
databases.utility: Metabolic pathway analysis, gene interaction and signaling (zebrafish via computational orthology inference).

databases.name: GEO NCBI
databases.data_type: Gene count/expression data from published papers

databases.name: UCSC Cell Browser
databases.utility: Visualize lineage trajectories and cell populations; aggregates published scRNA-seq datasets.
databases.data_type: Cell lineages across body regions / species

databases.name: STRING DB
databases.utility: Which proteins work with which genes and which signaling is activated (PREDICTIVE).

databases.name: IntAct
databases.utility: Complement to BioGRID and STRING — PHYSICAL, verified interactions.

databases.name: BioGRID
databases.utility: How genes interact with each other and with proteins; GENETIC interactions (what happens to the embryo if you alter two genes at once).

databases.name: Ensembl Zebrafish (Danio rerio)
databases.utility: Functional human equivalents (a dictionary); the authoritative identifier resolver behind the DATA INAMOVIBLE.
databases.data_type: Promoter sequences, gene annotation/comparison, variants, human orthologs

databases.name: CNGB STOmics (ZESTA / spatial atlases)
databases.utility: Spatial + temporal transcriptomic atlases (Stereo-seq). ZESTA = Zebrafish Embryogenesis Spatiotemporal Transcriptomic Atlas (3-24 hpf; Liu et al. Dev Cell 2022). NEW source added 2026-06-11 from the corpus-feasibility test (recommend-and-apply, additive).
databases.data_type: Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics + scRNA-seq .h5ad; SAW pipeline; SCENIC cisTarget; imaging; developmental trajectories

provenance_note: STRING is predictive; IntAct/BioGRID are physical/genetic (verified). When an interaction claim is made, prefer physical (IntAct) over predictive (STRING), and tag the provenance — mirrors the LBPP discipline.
